description: Utility class providing methods for URL construction, hashing, and request information extraction in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: MiscUtils
classes.description: A utility class for URL, hashing, and request-related helper methods.

methods.name: missingProperty
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating a required property is missing.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns a HashFunction instance based on the provided name.

methods.name: constructBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs a base URL from an HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URL scheme (http or https) from the request, considering headers.

methods.name: getDomainName
methods.description: Returns the server name from the request.

methods.name: getDomainNameAndPort
methods.description: Returns the domain name with port if non-default port is used.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Determines the port number from the request, considering forwarded headers.
